engineeringSkip.reason: No real research programme exists for bacteria performing quantum computation; it is a speculative mash-up of synthetic biology and quantum computing without a basis in known physics.

factCheck.reason: Quantum computers need extreme isolation and cold, controlled conditions, while bacteria are warm, wet and noisy environments that destroy quantum states — so 'quantum bacteria' is a mash-up of two incompatible ideas rather than a real engineering field.
